COMMENT.description:
COMMENT lines of the message (CCSDS 502.0-B-3), from its header, metadata
and data groups, in message order, joined by a line feed.

CLASSIFICATION.description:
CLASSIFICATION of the message: the optional header keyword stating its
security classification or handling caveat.

MESSAGE_ID.description:
MESSAGE_ID: the optional header keyword, an identifier the originator makes
unique for this message.

REF_FRAME_EPOCH.description: REF_FRAME_EPOCH: epoch of REF_FRAME when the frame is defined at one.

COV_REF_FRAME.description:
COV_REF_FRAME: the frame of COVARIANCE (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 3-6); empty
when it is REF_FRAME.

COVARIANCE.description:
Position/velocity covariance matrix, 6x6 lower triangle by rows, 21 values:
CX_X, CY_X, CY_Y, CZ_X, CZ_Y, CZ_Z, CX_DOT_X, CX_DOT_Y, CX_DOT_Z,
CX_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_X, CY_DOT_Y, CY_DOT_Z, CY_DOT_X_DOT, CY_DOT_Y_DOT,
CZ_DOT_X, CZ_DOT_Y, CZ_DOT_Z, CZ_DOT_X_DOT, CZ_DOT_Y_DOT, CZ_DOT_Z_DOT.
Units km**2, km**2/s, km**2/s**2. Empty when the message states none.

MANEUVERS.description: The message's maneuvers, in message order.

USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS.description: Every USER_DEFINED_x keyword of the message, in message order.

OPMManeuver.description: One maneuver of an OPM (CCSDS 502.0-B-3 Table 3-7).

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this maneuver, joined by a line feed.

MAN_DURATION.description: MAN_DURATION: duration of the burn in seconds; zero for an impulsive maneuver.

MAN_DELTA_MASS.description: MAN_DELTA_MASS: mass change during the maneuver in kg, negative or zero.

MAN_REF_FRAME.description: MAN_REF_FRAME: frame of MAN_DV_1..3 (for example RTN, TNW, or REF_FRAME's).

MAN_DV_1.description: MAN_DV_1: first component of the velocity increment in km/s.

MAN_DV_2.description: MAN_DV_2: second component of the velocity increment in km/s.

MAN_DV_3.description: MAN_DV_3: third component of the velocity increment in km/s.

OPMUserDefinedParameter.description:
One USER_DEFINED_x keyword of an OPM, or one USER_DEFINED element of its XML
form: the parameter name (the x) and the value as written.

PARAM_NAME.description: x, the part of the keyword after USER_DEFINED_ (the XML parameter attribute)
